market_view: VIX down 4.5% intraday to 15.29 and indices modestly green, but this does not change the rules-based hard stop on QQQ 690/681p which has been in breach for multiple cycles. QQQ -2.69% on the week remains the dominant regime risk for both put verticals.

QQQ 690/681p.reasoning: Mid-cost 1.665 is 1.616x the 1.03 credit — hard stop triggers at 1.5x (1.545). This breach has now persisted across multiple review cycles with no recovery below threshold; the rule has been triggered and must be executed.

QQQ 677/668p.reasoning: Mid-cost 1.10 is above the 1.07 credit entry (slight loser), and carrying two QQQ put verticals on the same expiry creates unacceptable single-underlying concentration — this must close after or simultaneously with the 690/681p.

SLV 61.5/60.5p.reasoning: Mid-cost 0.55 is flat to entry, short strike 2.1% OTM, 131 DTE with zero time pressure, and fully uncorrelated to the QQQ book being closed.
